name: Uber Pet
notes: 喺 App 揀 Uber Pet，實際供應、價格同可帶動物以平台確認為準。
notes_en: Select Uber Pet in the app. Confirm availability, price and accepted animals with the platform.

name: 輕鐵貓狗同行
notes: 只適用於周六、周日同公眾假期；須購買有效攜帶證，寵物全程放喺合規寵物袋。唔適用於其他港鐵網絡。
notes_en: Available on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays with a valid carrying pass. Keep your pet in a compliant carrier throughout the journey. Other MTR networks are not covered.

name: 九巴寵物巴士
notes: 指定寵物巴士服務，路線、日期同購票安排請喺 APP1933 核實；唔代表所有九巴路線可以帶寵物。
notes_en: A dedicated pet bus service. Check routes, dates and tickets in APP1933. This does not permit pets on all KMB routes.
